title: Redundant Network Link
description: In a communication network, a set of nodes labeled from 1 to N started as a tree of N nodes with N-1 edges. One additional edge was added to this network, creating a cycle. You are given a 2D array edges representing the network connections where edges[i] = [ui, vi] denotes an edge between nodes ui and vi. Return an edge that can be removed so that the resulting graph is a tree of N nodes. If there are multiple answers, return the answer that occurs last in the given 2D array.
output_format: An array of 2 integers representing the edge to remove.

examples.explanation: The given network forms a cycle: 1-2, 2-3, 3-1. Removing [2,3] breaks the cycle.
The edge [1,4] forms a cycle with 1-2, 2-3, 3-4.
Removing [3,1] leaves a valid tree structure.
